rules.title: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.requirement: This bill would have authorized the city of Boston to create its own rent stabilization program, but the bill was not enacted and was instead accompanied by a study order, effectively ending its progress in this session.
rules.coverage_conditions: Would have applied to rental housing within the city of Boston if enacted.
rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.conflict_note: Bill did not pass; final legislative action was 'Accompanied a study order, see H5035' on 9/9/2024, indicating it was shelved rather than enacted or formally voted down.

rules.title: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.requirement: This bill would have authorized the city of Boston to adopt tenant eviction protections (just-cause style rules), but it was not enacted and was instead accompanied by a study order.
rules.coverage_conditions: Would have applied to rental housing within the city of Boston if enacted.
rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.conflict_note: Bill did not pass; final legislative action was 'Accompanied a study order, see H5035' on 9/9/2024, indicating it was shelved rather than enacted or formally voted down.
